cohort: 701 women who underwent single vitrified-warmed cleavage-stage embryo transfers
finding: Fatty acid supplemented warming solutions improved live birth rates after single vitrified-warmed cleavage-stage embryo transfers without exerting any adverse effects on maternal and obstetric outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found no difference in cesarean section rates between the group using fatty acid-supplemented warming solutions for vitrified embryos and the control group.
birth_weight: Mentioned as an outcome, but no specific weight provided
